working:
$T_{r+1}=\binom{9}{r}x^{9-r}(-2)^r x^{-2r}=\binom{9}{r}(-2)^r x^{9-3r}$.\n$9-3r=0\Rightarrow r=3$.\nCoefficient $=\binom{9}{3}(-2)^3=-672$.

Independent check: The general term has power of x equal to 9−3k. Setting this to 0 gives k=3; the coefficient is C(9,3)(−2)^3=−672.
solution:
The general term is $T_{r+1} = \binom{9}{r}(-2)^r x^{9-3r}$. For the term independent of $x$, set $9-3r=0$, giving $r=3$.
$$\binom{9}{3}(-2)^3 = -672$$
